messages:
maya: FYI Acme is seeing requests routed to eu-1 even though they send X-Client-Region: us-west-2. High p95 latency and timeouts. ticket #INC-4521 :thinking:

acme-dev: yes, started after we added a CDN param rewrite. examples: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "X-Client-Region: us-west-2" "https://api.redwood.ai/generate?region=eu-1"

maya: exact — they unintentionally have region=eu-1 appended by our partner proxy. root requests include both header and query param. routing seems to prefer the query param right now.

alex: can you paste one request-id and the routing decision log? oncall needs it.

acme-dev: request-id=rid_20260303_8472. From their edge logs: 
```
PROXY -> api.edge
headers: {X-Client-Region: us-west-2}
url: /generate?region=eu-1
request-id=rid_20260303_8472
```

maya: attaching our gateway log snippet for the same request: 
```
[2026-03-03T15:12:07Z] rid_20260303_8472 route_decision=region=eu-1 source=query_param
```

sanjay: that log line is the smoking gun — routing layer currently gives precedence to query param when both present. bug introduced in 2025-11 routing-refactor (PR #314).

alex: :exclamation: that's bad — cross-region egress adds 200-400ms for them. escalation: ops oncall? ops-bot, can you show last deploys touching router?

ops-bot: Deploys touching service=router in last 30d: 2026-02-28 routing-refactor v2.1.3 (PR #314), 2026-03-01 hotfix for header-parse (PR #322). No change to precedence.

acme-dev: impact: p95 went from 120ms -> 520ms. Some requests hit rate limits in eu-1 causing 429s. Customers are upset.

maya: proposed mitigations: 1) quick config change to prefer header over param at edge (hotfix) 2) short-term rewrite to strip region query param for Acme via CDN rule 3) longer fix: unit tests + explicit precedence policy and e2e tests.

sanjay: agree. I can ship a 1-line change in routing code to prefer header when both present and add metric. plan: branch -> canary -> prod in <2h. will also add a guard to return 400 if both present for 1 week toggle.

alex: please include request-id rid_20260303_8472 in the canary tracing. ops-bot, create incident and page oncall.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-4521. Oncall paged: pagerduty#ops. Canary rollout planned at 15:40 UTC.

maya: I've informed Acme support and recommended the CDN strip as interim. keeping them in loop. I'll update ticket with canary link and expected timeline. :white_check_mark:
